text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Workers' Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA) announces a nationwide stoppage on Saturday to mourn its slain leader Abdelhak Benhamouda.
- The government adopts nine measures to boost non-oil and gas exports.
- Benhamouda's martyrdom might trigger a stronger mobilisation against terror and bloodshed and against politicians' incapacity to manage the five-year-old crisis.
- Bomb kills one person and wounds 10.

- Beyond the violence which is crippling the country, Benhamouda's murder raises anew the question of the systematic extermination of Algeria's elite who advocate universal values, democracy and social justice.
- Sources suspect Moslem fundamentalist FIDA group of killing Benhamouda.
- UGTA to hold special congress after Benhamouda's murder.
